verdicts.reason: The two candidates use nearly the same layout: quote on the left, and the can in a circle cropped at the bottom right. The can is small, its 'SOLSTICE' label is barely legible, and the left text column leaves a lot of empty space around it. A wraps the quote more evenly ('and gone too soon.' ends cleanly), but its attribution is a bit big and sits tight under the quote. B leaves the short 'too soon.' as its last line, and its attribution has become small and weak.
